highCommissioner.quote: True diplomacy begins with empowering young African leaders to master statecraft, negotiate with sovereignty, and connect our nations through intellectual excellence and principled dialogue.
highCommissioner.bio: Suleiman Yusuf Othman is the High Commissioner and Founder of GILD International (Global Institute for Leadership & Diplomacy). He serves as the High Commissioner of the African Society of International Relations Students (ASIRS) and President of the Department of International Relations & Diplomacy at Kaduna State University (KASU). A dedicated diplomatic scholar, pan-African youth envoy, and student leader in Kaduna, Nigeria, he established GILD International alongside 7 fellow student leaders from the Department of International Relations & Diplomacy and the Department of Political Science to build a sovereign platform for diplomatic simulations, leadership mastery, and inter-university summits across Nigeria and Africa.
